name: siteseo
description: Search and AI search readiness auditing for sites you own. Audits a local build directory or a live URL, reports findings with raw evidence and a source link for each, keeps search health and AI access as two separate scores, pulls first-party Search Console and Bing data into dated history committed to the site repo, tracks whether AI assistants cite you, applies safe fixes to source templates behind a diff, and gates deploys with no model calls and no paid API calls.
